Back on the order side, Zach, and I'm sorry. Three weeks for a return label is indefensible.

Where it actually stands: your NerdQX return has never been opened on our side, which is why no label reached you. I've pushed it through as the one thing that needs signing off this morning, with the fault detail and your reference Shop···· attached.

The team starts at 10am Eastern today and this is first in front of them. The label comes to (email hidden), so you don't need to sit here.
Does everyone have to go through this bs to get returns/repairs?

No. The normal run is the form, a tech look, then a prepaid label, usually a few days. Yours stalled because the return was never opened on our side, and nobody caught it. That's a failure on us, not how it's meant to work.

Nothing else is needed from you. The approval is the only thing left, and your label goes to (email hidden) once it's signed off this morning.
Ill believe it when I see it. Ill be waiting for the email to end this night mare of a purchase.

Fair. You've been told things before that didn't happen, so I'm not going to ask you to take my word for it.

Watch for the label email at (email hidden) Reference Shop···· goes on the outside of the box. A copy of this conversation comes to you by email once we're done here too.

If it isn't in your hands by Monday, come back here and say so.
